title: Flat finite-presentation ring maps induce open maps on spectra
statement: Let $R\to S$ be a flat ring map [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. Then the induced map $\operatorname{Spec}(S)\to\operatorname{Spec}(R)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] is open: the image of every open subset is open.
